response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong DLang, TypeScript, and Node.js expertise plus notable geospatial GIS project experience, but he lacks demonstrable modern C++ or Rust experience (his C++ exposure is a decade old and minimal) and has no evidence of routing/navigation pipeline, distributed-systems fault tolerance, or real-time traffic integration work, making him a weak match for this C++/Rust-centric routing tiling role.
strengths: Founder of an open-source geospatial (GIS) platform with real-world mapping deployments (Green Map)
Deep full-stack and systems programming versatility across many languages and paradigms (DLang, Node.js, TypeScript, C++, Java)
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and adopting rigorous engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (2014-2015) with no Rust experience at all
No direct experience with routing/navigation guidance systems, traffic data integration, or tiling pipelines
No evidence of distributed-systems concepts like fault tolerance, consistency, or service discovery in recent roles

key_factors.factor: No routing/navigation or traffic pipeline experience
